items.title: LIVESTOCK
items.author: Maverick
items.content:
This patch we are introducing cows and sheep.
What resources can THEY GIVE?
Both produce
dung
, cows produce
milk,
and sheep produce
wool
.
They can also be harvested for meat, bones and leather like any other animal.
Additionally, you can sell a grown animal to an NPC in the ranch.
How to set up a farm?
There are multiple ways to capture wild livestock, some more efficient than others, but they should all be pretty intuitive.
When the new navmesh is enabled,
NPCs can enter player structures
and respect doors opening/closing, so the sky is the limit.
Like plants, they have
genetics
and needs, and can be bred to hunt for a god clone.
However, the genes won't behave exactly like plants, so old techniques may not apply.
WILL IT TANK PERFORMANCE?
Each game frame, only a subset of the NPCs are processed, up to a hardcoded max time per frame.
So when we increase the population, the server doesn't directly lose FPS, instead NPCs just become slower to react because we distribute the load across frames automatically when over budget.
We still spent time multithreading and optimising the new navigation system, at least doubling its performance since the last patch.
As usual, we'll be monitoring server performance and fixing problems as they appear.
items.reason: Es la adición principal del parche. Añadir vacas, ovejas, genética y mecánicas de granja cambia por completo el meta y genera muchísima expectativa.

items.title: Anticheat: Additional Secure Servers
items.author: Ryan
items.content:
Back in March we introduced the ability for servers to
require TPM + Secure Boot
, enabling it for 6 of our own servers.
Over the last 6+ months we have seen security feature adoption grow at a steady pace and we're ready to switch more servers to secure, continuing with the following Facepunch servers:
[US East] Facepunch 1
[EA] Facepunch 1
[EU] Facepunch 15
[EU East] Facepunch 1
[EU] Facepunch 16
[EA] Facepunch 2
Our desired goal is still to make it global for all servers in Rust, but we still have some ways to go for adoption, see adoption rates over the last 6+ months:
If your hardware supports it, we would strongly recommend you take steps to enable these features, see
this support page
. If you have TPM and Secure Boot already enabled feel free to give a secure server a chance, we were able to determine a
reduced cheater presence
on these servers a month after release.
items.reason: El combate contra los cheaters siempre genera conversación masiva, debate y alto interés en la comunidad.

items.title: POWERGRID LOOT ROOMS
items.author: Damian Lazarski
items.content:
Building on the Powerplant loot room introduced in the Power Trip update, we’ve added new loot rooms to many other monuments. These rooms are locked by default and become accessible once enough Heavy Fuses have been inserted into the Powerplant to generate the required power. The number of Heavy Fuses needed to unlock each room varies, with more challenging monuments requiring more fuses than beginner-friendly ones.
We won’t spoil the exact locations of these new rooms, but you’ll find them at the following monuments:
Airfield
Ferry Terminal
Harbour 1
Harbour 2
Ferry Terminal
Junkyard
Launch Site
Military Tunnels
Nuclear Missile Silo
Radtown
Sewer Branch
Trainyard
Water Treatment Plant
items.reason: Revoluciona el looteo de monumentos al añadir nuevas salas secretas que requieren fusibles y energía, dinamizando el mapa.

items.title: Air wolf repairable helipad
items.author: Martyn Chapman
items.content:
At the start of the wipe the Air Wolf helipad in Bandit Camp will now be in a state of disrepair. The air vehicle vendor NPC will refuse to sell vehicles to anyone until the helipad is repaired.
Repairing the helipad is a process similar to constructing siege weapons - a certain amount of resources are required and you can transfer resources from your inventory by bashing the helipad with a hammer. Once the helipad is repaired it stays repaired for the duration of the wipe.
The intention is that repairing the helipad requires a communal effort and air vehicles purchased from this vendor should no longer start spawning too quickly into the start of the wipe. If a clan wishes to get quick access to air vehicles they are required to invest a significant amount of resources to do so and they are also opening up access to the vendor to everyone else on the server.
Server admins can change this behaviour via convars
vehicle.padrepairsrequired
(if false this change is effectively reverted) and
vehicle.setrepairablepads
(force helipad into fully disrepaired/repaired state with 0/1)
items.reason: Cambia drásticamente la progresión del early game al frenar el acceso inmediato a los minicopters, obligando a un esfuerzo comunitario o de clanes.

items.title: Client Predicted Grenades/Explosives
items.author: Ian Henderson
items.content:
Grenades/C4/Satchels in Rust are server-sided. This means when you left-click, your client will tell the server that it has to spawn the grenade or c4, etc and then we have to wait for the server to do so. With higher ping, this can feel like a substantial wait.
We are now introducing some client prediction when you use a grenade/c4/satchel. This means that throwing these items will now feel way smoother (especially on higher pings) as your local client will simulate what will happen on the server before the server has to tell us, but don't worry: if there are any discrepancies, your client will be corrected. This shouldn't happen too often, but it will kick in when it needs to.
items.reason: Mejora sustancialmente la calidad de vida en el PvP para jugadores con ping alto al predecir la física de explosivos y granadas.

items.title: Biofuel Generator
items.author: Ian Henderson
items.content:
A way to finally make use of raw or spoiled meat. The Biofuel Generator converts organic matter to low grade, but it must be stirred by hand!
You can fill it up, stir it and let it process. It will take around 30~ minutes before you'll have to stir again, but don't worry - you can hook up some IO to let you know it needs stirring even when you're in the next room.
The amount of low grade you're given depends on the type of organic matter you put in, those with a larger calorific value will give you more low grade.
items.reason: Resuelve un problema clásico del juego (dar uso a la carne podrida) y añade interacción con circuitos eléctricos (IO), ideal para debate.

items.title: Milk
items.author: Jarryd Campi
items.content:
Cows give you access to a new resource - milk. It can be consumed as is, but if you refrigerate it for 4 hours, you will gain a new option to skim the milk. Skimming the milk will give you two items - Skimmed Milk and Cream. Cream is a more powerful consumable.
Milk and Cream can also be used in a variety of crafting recipes. Milk will generally increase the duration of tea effects, while Cream can be used to increase the potency of those effects.
items.reason: La mecánica de refrigerar leche para obtener crema y potenciar los tés es muy interesante y llamativa para los jugadores dedicados al PvP y farm.
